title: Brewery: Drunk Messages
description: Makes drunk players sound even drunker by distorting their chat messages based on their alcohol level.
body: # Brewery: Drunk Messages Makes drunk players sound even drunker by distorting their chat messages based on their alcohol level. ## Installation Requires [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) and [Patbox's Brewery](https://modrinth.com/mod/brewery). - Server-side only - No client installation required - Multiplayer compatible ## Note This mod was made for my own server and is shared publicly for anyone who wants to use it. Updates are primarily driven by the needs of my server. Backports to older versions are not planned. Anyone is welcome to port this mod to other Minecraft versions. ## Credits [Patbox's Brewery](https://modrinth.com/mod/brewery) by Patbox
